title: Exterior sheaves commute with full-open restriction and pushforward
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $M$ be a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and let $d\in\mathbf N$. Let $j:X|_X\to X$ be the inclusion of the full-open subscheme into $X$, and let $j^*M$ be the restriction of $M$ to that open subscheme. Writing $\bigwedge^d$ for the sheafification of sectionwise exterior powers [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power], there is an isomorphism of module sheaves $j_*(\bigwedge^d(j^*M))\cong\bigwedge^d M$. No local freeness hypothesis is imposed on $M$.

proof.text: Apply exteriorSheaf_restrict_iso M d to the full open. Its inverse identifies the exterior sheaf of the restricted module with the restriction of the exterior sheaf. Compose with Mathlib restrictFunctorIsoPullback and the upstream pullbackIsoPushforwardInv for the scheme isomorphism X.topIso.hom. Push this isomorphism forward. The pushforwardComp, pushforwardCongr for inv j ≫ j = 𝟙 X, and pushforwardId isomorphisms identify the resulting pushforward along the inverse and then j with the original exterior sheaf. These functor isomorphisms apply to every module sheaf, including degree zero and the empty scheme.
